statements.query: MATCH (dataset:GCPBigqueryDataset{exposed_internet:true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WITH dataset LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE dataset.exposed_internet, dataset.exposed_internet_type return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Tables only inherit exposure from their dataset (last statement), so reset them too; without this a table stayed public after its dataset was made private.
statements.query: MATCH (table:GCPBigqueryTable{exposed_internet:true})<-[:HAS_TABLE]-(:GCPBigqueryDataset)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WITH table LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE table.exposed_internet, table.exposed_internet_type return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: The dataset access list is the dataset's IAM policy. allUsers comes back as an iamMember entry; allAuthenticatedUsers as a specialGroup (or an iamMember). Any role counts.
statements.query:
MATCH (access:GCPAcl)-[a:APPLIES_TO]->(dataset:GCPBigqueryDataset)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
UNWIND [m IN [access.special_group, access.iam_member] WHERE m IN ['allUsers', 'allAuthenticatedUsers']] AS member
SET dataset.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT member IN coalesce(dataset.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN dataset END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(dataset.exposed_internet_type, []) + member

MATCH (table:GCPBigqueryTable)<-[r:HAS_TABLE]-(dataset:GCPBigqueryDataset)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
WHERE dataset.exposed_internet = true 
SET table.exposed_internet = true, table.exposed_internet_type = dataset.exposed_internet_type

name: GCP BigQuery public policy exposure analysis
